ai-scoping: We review your current systems, meet with your decision-makers, and write a plan for what to build, buy, or improve. Includes one meeting day and two days of preparation and follow-up. See the full scope for the build or implementation credit.
ai-policy: Clear rules for which AI tools people may use, what data they may share, and who approves exceptions. Includes an inventory of current use and supporting records.
ai-governance: Set up who approves AI use, how decisions are recorded, and how problems are handled. Includes a model and vendor inventory, monitoring procedures, and board reporting. Annual updates are quoted separately.
ai-provider: Compare AI platforms, costs, data handling, and options for changing providers. You receive a written recommendation and system design.
ai-node: Set up production AI on one server you own. We help choose the model and train or fine-tune it with your data, within an agreed scope. Includes access controls, testing, monitoring, documentation, and administrator handover. Hardware, licenses, travel, and ongoing support cost extra.
ai-cluster: Design and build private AI across multiple servers, from a small cluster to a large GPU installation. Includes performance testing and monitoring. Priced for your project.
buildout: Build a computing cluster or production AI factory. We handle system design, procurement assistance, setup, networking, storage, job scheduling, testing, and handover.
diag-fabric: Find what is slowing the connections between your servers. Covers InfiniBand (QDR through XDR), RoCE v1/v2, and Ethernet. For GPU systems, we also use NCCL tests to check how well GPUs share data within and across servers. If you use NVIDIA UFM to manage your network, we review and tune its settings within the agreed scope. You get measurements, written findings, and a review of the results.
diag-storage: Set up and test your parallel filesystem and server connections. We check speed, find bottlenecks, tune the agreed setup, and show your team how to run it.
diag-scheduler: Set up the software that assigns computing jobs to your servers. We configure queues, resource sharing, GPU scheduling, and usage records, test your workloads, and hand over to your team.
diag-acceptance: Test a cluster against agreed performance requirements. You receive measured results and a report you can share with the vendor. Retesting is quoted separately.
ai-sounding: Answer one business question using three data exports. In five business days, you receive a short report on whether there is a problem worth investigating. This does not estimate its dollar value. The fee is credited toward a diagnostic.
ai-diagnostic: Review about 30 summaries and reports to find areas that need a closer look. This does not include reading the underlying contracts or full transaction records. The fee is credited toward an operating review.
ai-review-unit: A detailed review of one business unit, including transaction records, payroll, and contracts. Findings include supporting evidence, estimated annual financial impact, and recommended actions.
ai-review-org: Review multiple business units or entities. The scope and price depend on the number of units and industries involved. Use the main ordering page for a quote.
ai-implementation: Help put agreed review findings into practice. The work and price are set after the findings are reviewed.
